input: Find a grief counselor specializing in pregnancy loss

gold.taskTitle: Find a Grief Counselor for Pregnancy Loss
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a grief counselor who specializes in pregnancy loss.

questions.title: What type of pregnancy loss are you navigating?
questions.description: Understanding whether this involves miscarriage, stillbirth, termination for medical reasons, or another form of loss helps identify the most relevant specialization.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person sessions or telehealth?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred format determines whether to search locally or across a broader geographic range.

questions.title: What city or region should the search focus on?
questions.description: A specific location is needed to find nearby or regionally accessible counselors.

questions.title: Do you have a preference for individual or couples counseling?
questions.description: Pregnancy loss affects partners differently; knowing whether one or both people will attend shapes the type of counselor needed.

questions.title: What insurance plan, if any, needs to be accepted?
questions.description: Insurance compatibility is a key filter when narrowing down viable counselor options.

questions.title: Is a specific counselor credential important to you?
questions.description: Some people prefer a licensed therapist, psychologist, social worker, or a faith-based counselor, which affects where to search.

questions.title: How soon do you need to begin seeing someone?
questions.description: Urgency determines whether to prioritize counselors with immediate availability or allow time for a more thorough search.
